manifest.name: dsh-nord
manifest.description: Nord theme, a settings row, and a DeepSeek balance readout with a detail panel for the dsh Web GUI. Selectable font stacks on dsh before 0.2.1; newer hosts own their font settings and this plugin steps aside.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build

bundle.text:
# dsh-nord bundle layer.
#
# The row names the package, not a path: after
# `dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-nord` the Loader resolves it from the
# profile's own node_modules. Replace with a file:// URL only when loading the
# checkout build through a `--patch` overlay.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-nord
      name: 'dsh-nord'

readme.text:
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nord)

**中文** | [English](https://github.com/verdana/dsh-nord/blob/main/README.en.md)

给 [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI 换一套 Nord：Nord 配色、一页自己的设置，以及 composer 下方的 DeepSeek 余额读数。dsh **0.2.1** 起字体与字号由 dsh 自己管理，0.1.7 / 0.2.0 上本插件仍提供字体替换。本插件只支持 **0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1** 三代，`≤ 0.1.5` 自 0.4.0 起不再支持。

> 版本与逐版变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)；npm 上的最新版本见上方 badge。

- **Nord 配色** —— 132 个设计 token（93 个语义 alias、10 个具名表面、29 个静态色阶补丁），浅色与深色两套，跟随 dsh 的「外观」设置切换；不写死颜色、不改 DOM，卸载即还原。
- **字体可选** —— 界面字体与代码字体分开选：跟随系统、八个预设（Maple Mono、JetBrains Mono、Cascadia Code、Fira Code、更纱黑体、霞鹜文楷、HarmonyOS Sans、MiSans），或者自己填一条 CSS `font-family`。预设是一整条回退栈，没装的家族自动落到下一个，中文回退由插件补在后面；下拉里的每一行用它自己的字体渲染，所以挑之前就能看到实际效果。界面字号仍跟随 dsh 的「字号大小」设置派生。

> dsh **0.2.1** 起自带字体与字号设置（设置 → 通用 → 字体），本插件随之让位：不再注入任何字体样式表，设置页的字体组只留一行说明。更早的支持版本（0.1.7 / 0.2.0）仍由本插件提供字体替换。
- **余额读数** —— composer 下方，与官方的轮次/步骤统计在同一行。点击弹出明细面板。用 DeepSeek 模型时（或余额接口就是 DeepSeek 时），面板底部多一行「用量信息」，直达 [platform.deepseek.com/usage](https://platform.deepseek.com/usage)；其他供应商的面板保持原样。

- **独立的设置页** —— 设置面板左栏多一项「Nord 主题」，排在官方分区之后；本插件不再往「通用」里塞行。左栏那一行用自己的调色板图标，页面底部一条分隔线下面是当前版本号。页面分外观、字体、余额条三组；dsh 0.2.1 起字体组改为一行委托说明（字体由 dsh 自己的设置管理）。

> 截图是深色下的样子（浅色由同一套 token 的另一半驱动）。三张图由 `node scripts/shots/capture.mjs` 在隔离实例里重拍，见 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md#截图怎么来的)。设置页那张是 dsh 0.2.1 上的样子：字体组只留一行委托说明。

- **宽表格不再抖动** —— 修掉 dsh 上游的一处布局问题：鼠标停在 markdown 宽表格底边时，表格会因为悬停预留高度来回切换而抖动。补丁把 `md-table-wide` 钉在普通 `overflow-x: auto`，不写 DOM、卸载即还原；代价是横向放不下的宽表格会常驻显示横向滚动条（放得下的宽表格照旧没有滚动条）。详见 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md#宽表格为什么被钉在-auto)。

- 支持的 dsh：**`0.2.2-rc.1`**（构建基线，实机实测）、**`0.2.1-rc.5`**、**`0.2.0-rc.2`**，各自实测过；**`0.1.7` 已退出实测窗口**（代码仍在、装上去照常能用，下一次大版本一并删除），**`≤ 0.1.5` 自 0.4.0 起不再支持**，详见[兼容性](#兼容性)。
- 余额读数需要 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（由 dsh 的 credentials 服务解析）。没有凭据时余额条显示错误文案，主题、字体、设置不受影响。

| dsh | 状态 | 字体 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.2` | 构建基线（`rc.1` 实测） | 字体与字号由 dsh 自己的设置管理；插件不注入任何字体 |
| `0.2.1` | 实测（`rc.5`） | 同上 |
| `0.2.0` | 实测（`rc.2`） | 插件提供字体替换（界面 / 代码字体可选） |
| `0.1.7` | 出窗：代码仍在，不再实测 | 同上 |
| `≤ 0.1.5` | **0.4.0 起不再支持**（含 `0.1.5-rc.1` / `rc.2` / `rc.3` 及更早全部版本） | — |

0.4.0 移除了 0.1.5 一代的兼容代码：那一代的设置命名空间是另一套接口（Host `installSection` + 浏览器 `settingsScope`），代码为此维护两份 schema 与双份设置传输。**dsh 发布很频繁，插件只保留当前基线加上两代回退，不对更老的版本做兼容。** 基线升到 `0.2.2` 后窗口就是 `0.2.2` / `0.2.1` / `0.2.0`，`0.1.7` 因此出窗；它那一代的装载器不读 `engines.dsh`，删代码留给下一个大版本，本轮不动。

这条下限同时写进了 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`（`>=0.1.7-0`）：dsh 0.2.1 及以后会在安装与启动时直接拒绝更老的宿主，并提示用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 给一个只对这个版本生效的豁免（仅供临时验证，不代表恢复兼容）。0.1.7 / 0.2.0 本身不读该字段，所以那两个版本仍照常可用；**0.1.5 也不读，因此它拦不住 0.4.x 的安装——别在 0.1.5 上升级，请留在插件 0.3.x。** 更完整的版本记录见 [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md#版本现实)。

从 npm：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nord
dsh web
```

不写版本号时 pnpm 解 `latest` 标签。注意 pnpm 11 起默认有 24 小时的「新版本冷静期」：某个版本发布不满一天时，`@latest` 解析不到它，会静默装回上一个版本（刚发版后想立刻验证时很容易踩到）。要装某个确切版本就直接写全，版本号看上方 badge 或 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)，例如 `dsh-nord@<版本>`。

从本仓库源码：

```sh
npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # 应出现 "# == dsh-nord"
dsh web

从 GitHub 直接装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:verdana/dsh-nord#main
```

`#main` 取的是分支最新提交；想锁死到某次提交，把 `main` 换成 commit sha 即可。

git 安装需要你在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里为该包授权构建脚本（`allowBuilds`），dsh 首次失败时会提示要粘贴的确切内容——这项授权等于允许该包在安装期执行代码，只对可信源码开放。不想让用户做这步，就用上面的 npm 或本地路径安装。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-nord`。

0.4.0 收窄了支持范围、也改变了字体的接管方式，升级时先移除再装（0.2.1 起 HMR 装载的 profile 不接受对已安装包直接 `add`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-nord
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nord
```

如果 dsh 还停在 `≤ 0.1.5`，别升到 0.4.x：先把 dsh 升到 0.1.7 或更新的支持版本，否则就留在插件 0.3.x（0.1.5 不会读 `engines.dsh`，拦不住这次安装）。

装好后打开设置确认「Nord 主题」那一页还在：0.2.1 上字体组只剩一行说明，字体改在设置 → 通用 → 字体里选；0.2.0 / 0.1.7 上仍是插件自己的字体菜单，原有选择会沿用。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `themeEnabled` | true | 叠加 Nord 配色 |
| `fontEnabled` | true | 替换字体栈；关掉即回到 dsh 自带字体 |
| `uiFont` | `maple` | 界面字体：预设 id、`system`（跟随系统）或 `custom` |
| `uiFontCustom` | 空 | `uiFont: custom` 时使用的 CSS `font-family` 列表 |
| `codeFont` | `maple` | 代码字体：预设 id、`system`、`inherit`（跟随界面）或 `custom` |
| `codeFontCustom` | 空 | `codeFont: custom` 时使用的 CSS `font-family` 列表 |
| `balanceEnabled` | true | 显示底部余额条 |
| `refreshSeconds` | 60 | 余额刷新间隔，15–3600 |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | 余额接口地址 |

预设 id：`maple`、`jetbrains`、`cascadia`、`fira`、`sarasa`、`lxgw`、`harmony`、`misans`。

> `fontEnabled` / `uiFont` / `uiFontCustom` / `codeFont` / `codeFontCustom` 只在 dsh **< 0.2.1** 生效。0.2.1 起字体与字号由 dsh 自己的设置（设置 → 通用 → 字体）管理，本插件不注入任何字体 token；这些字段保留，是为了旧文档仍能解析、降级回旧版本时原来的选择还在。

也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 `id: dsh-nord` 覆盖。patch 会**整体替换**目标行的 `config`，所以要重述所有键（缺的键由 schema 默认值补上，所以旧 patch 仍然能启动）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-nord
  config:
    themeEnabled: true
    fontEnabled: true
`uiFontCustom` / `codeFontCustom` 按 CSS `font-family` 语法写，逗号分隔，例如 `'LXGW WenKai', 'Microsoft YaHei'`。插件只保留能识别的家族名（分号、花括号、引号、括号等一律丢弃），再用引号重新拼好，并在末尾补上中文回退；`sans-serif` 这类通用族保持不加引号。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nord)

[中文](https://github.com/verdana/dsh-nord/blob/main/README.md) | **English**

A Nord repaint for the [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI: the Nord palette, a settings page of its own, and a DeepSeek balance readout under the composer. From dsh **0.2.1** the host manages fonts and sizes itself; on 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 this plugin still provides font replacement. Only dsh **0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1** are supported; `≤ 0.1.5` has been unsupported since 0.4.0.
> Version and per-release changes live in [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md); the latest version on npm is the badge above.

- **Nord palette** —— 132 design tokens (93 semantic aliases, 10 named surfaces, 29 raw-scale patches), one set for light and one for dark, following dsh's own *Appearance* setting. No hard-coded colors, no DOM surgery, and uninstalling restores everything.
- **Selectable fonts** —— Interface font and code font are chosen separately: follow the system, one of eight presets (Maple Mono, JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code, Fira Code, Sarasa Gothic, LXGW WenKai, HarmonyOS Sans, MiSans), or your own CSS `font-family` string. A preset is a full fallback stack, so a family you don't have installed drops through to the next one, with CJK fallbacks appended by the plugin; every row in the dropdown renders in its own font, so you see the real result before you pick it. The UI font size still derives from dsh's *Font size* setting.

> Starting with dsh **0.2.1**, the host ships its own font and size settings (Settings → General → Fonts), and this plugin steps aside: it injects no font stylesheet at all and the settings page's font group keeps a single explanatory line. On older supported hosts (0.1.7 / 0.2.0) the plugin still provides font replacement.
- **Balance readout** —— Below the composer, on the same row as the official turn/step stats. Click it for a detail panel. With a DeepSeek model (or when the balance endpoint itself is DeepSeek), the panel gains a *Usage* row linking to [platform.deepseek.com/usage](https://platform.deepseek.com/usage); panels for other providers are left untouched.

- **A settings page of its own** —— The settings panel's left nav gains a *Nord theme* entry after the official sections; the plugin no longer squeezes rows into *General*. The entry draws its own palette glyph, and the page ends with a divider and the current version number. The page is grouped into appearance, fonts, and the balance bar; from dsh 0.2.1 on, the font group becomes one line stating the delegation (fonts are managed by dsh's own settings).

> The screenshots show the dark scheme (light is driven by the other half of the same token set). All three are re-shot in an isolated instance by `node scripts/shots/capture.mjs` — see [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md#截图怎么来的) (Chinese). The settings shot is from dsh 0.2.1, where the font group is a single delegation line.

- **No more jittering wide tables** —— Fixes a layout bug in dsh itself: hovering the bottom edge of a wide markdown table makes it flicker, because the hover state reserves a different height than the resting state. The patch pins `md-table-wide` at a plain `overflow-x: auto` — no DOM writes, restored on uninstall. The cost is that a wide table too wide to fit now always shows a horizontal scrollbar (wide tables that do fit keep showing none). Details in [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md#宽表格为什么被钉在-auto) (Chinese).

- Supported dsh: **`0.2.2-rc.1`** (the build baseline, tested on a live instance), **`0.2.1-rc.5`**, and **`0.2.0-rc.2`**, each tested as well; **`0.1.7` has left the tested window** (its code path is still there and it still runs; the deletion is deferred to the next major), and **`≤ 0.1.5` has been unsupported since 0.4.0** — see [Compatibility](#compatibility).
- The balance readout needs `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` (resolved through dsh's credentials service). Without credentials the bar shows an error message; theme, fonts, and settings are unaffected.

| dsh | Status | Fonts |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.2` | Build baseline (`rc.1` tested) | Font family and size are managed by dsh's own settings; the plugin injects none |
| `0.2.1` | Tested (`rc.5`) | Same as above |
| `0.2.0` | Tested (`rc.2`) | The plugin provides font replacement (interface / code fonts) |
| `0.1.7` | Out of window: code still present, no longer tested | Same as above |
| `≤ 0.1.5` | **Unsupported since 0.4.0** (every `0.1.5-rc.1` / `rc.2` / `rc.3` and older) | — |

0.4.0 removed the 0.1.5 compatibility code: that generation exposed the settings namespace through a different pair of interfaces (Host `installSection` plus browser `settingsScope`), which the plugin had to support with two schemas and two transports. **dsh releases very frequently, so the plugin only keeps the current baseline plus two generations of fallback and does not maintain compatibility with older releases.** With the baseline now at `0.2.2`, that window is `0.2.2` / `0.2.1` / `0.2.0`, so `0.1.7` drops out; its loader never read `engines.dsh`, and removing its code path is left to the next major.

The floor is also declared in `package.json` as `engines.dsh` (`>=0.1.7-0`): dsh 0.2.1 and newer refuse older hosts at install and startup, pointing at `dsh plugin allow-version` for an exact-version exemption (for temporary verification only; it does not restore compatibility). 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 do not read that field, so they keep working as before. **0.1.5 does not read it either, so it cannot block a 0.4.x install — do not upgrade on 0.1.5; stay on plugin 0.3.x.** The fuller version history is in [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md#版本现实) (Chinese).

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nord
dsh web
```

Without a version, pnpm resolves the `latest` tag. Note that pnpm 11 introduces a 24-hour "new version cooldown": while a release is less than a day old, `@latest` does not resolve to it and silently installs the previous version instead (an easy trap right after publishing). For an exact version, spell it out — the number is in the badge above or in [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md), e.g. `dsh-nord@<version>`.

From this repository's source:

```sh
npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # should show "# == dsh-nord"
dsh web

Straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:verdana/dsh-nord#main
```

`#main` takes the tip of the branch; replace `main` with a commit sha to pin one.

Installing from git requires you to approve the package's build script (`allowBuilds`) in your profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`. dsh prints the exact line to paste on the first failure — that approval means letting the package run code at install time, so only do it for sources you trust. If you don't want users to take that step, install from npm or a local path as above.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-nord`.

0.4.0 narrows the supported range and changes how fonts are owned, so remove before installing (on HMR-loaded profiles since dsh 0.2.1 an `add` over an installed package is refused):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-nord
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nord
```

If dsh is still on `≤ 0.1.5`, do not move to 0.4.x: upgrade dsh to 0.1.7 or newer first, or stay on plugin 0.3.x (0.1.5 does not read `engines.dsh`, so it will not block this install).

After installing, open Settings and confirm the *Nord theme* page is there: on 0.2.1 the font group is one explanatory line and fonts are chosen in Settings → General → Fonts; on 0.2.0 / 0.1.7 the plugin's own font menus remain and keep their stored choices.
Settings panel → left nav *Nord theme* (after General, Models, Built-in Plugins, and Agent presets):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `themeEnabled` | true | Apply the Nord palette |
| `fontEnabled` | true | Replace the font stacks; turn off to go back to dsh's own fonts |
| `uiFont` | `maple` | Interface font: preset id, `system`, or `custom` |
| `uiFontCustom` | empty | CSS `font-family` list used when `uiFont: custom` |
| `codeFont` | `maple` | Code font: preset id, `system`, `inherit` (follow the interface font), or `custom` |
| `codeFontCustom` | empty | CSS `font-family` list used when `codeFont: custom` |
| `balanceEnabled` | true | Show the balance bar at the bottom |
| `refreshSeconds` | 60 | Balance refresh interval, 15–3600 |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | Balance endpoint |

Preset ids: `maple`, `jetbrains`, `cascadia`, `fira`, `sarasa`, `lxgw`, `harmony`, `misans`.

> `fontEnabled` / `uiFont` / `uiFontCustom` / `codeFont` / `codeFontCustom` only take effect on dsh **< 0.2.1**. From 0.2.1 the host manages fonts and sizes in its own settings (Settings → General → Fonts) and the plugin injects no font token at all; the fields stay so old documents still resolve and a downgrade keeps the previous choices.

You can also override by `id: dsh-nord` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch **replaces** the target row's whole `config`, so restate every key (missing keys fall back to schema defaults, so an old patch still boots):

```yaml
- id: dsh-nord
  config:
    themeEnabled: true
    fontEnabled: true

`uiFontCustom` / `codeFontCustom` take CSS `font-family` syntax, comma-separated, e.g. `'LXGW WenKai', 'Microsoft YaHei'`. The plugin keeps only the family names it can recognize (semicolons, braces, quotes, parentheses and the like are dropped), re-quotes them, and appends CJK fallbacks; generic families such as `sans-serif` stay unquoted.
